original_test_intent: Verify the PSU redundancy status record or records and per-PSU health across IB SDR/Sensor List, OOB SDR/Sensor List and BMC Web against the approved PSU topology and redundancy policy, without inducing a failover.
original_method: Bind each PSU slot, module identity and feed to the same SUT/BMC; identify actual redundancy and PSU-health records independent of the conflicting filters; retain complete aligned IB/OOB lists and Web views; decode healthy, degraded, lost-redundancy and failed states while distinguishing observed status from functional failover proof.
manual_activity: The owner resolves the AMBIENT/TEMP_MB filters, identifies redundancy records and policy and resolves criteria 3–76; an operator reviews per-slot Web health, then the owner decides the verdict.
required_inputs: Exact redundancy and per-PSU health record IDs/types
Protected access, full Web evidence, filter and criteria decisions
safety_requirements: Use read-only queries with protected credentials
Do not remove, disable, power-cycle or reconfigure a PSU
Do not infer failover/load-sharing from one status value
Do not use AMBIENT or TEMP_MB as PSU evidence without an approved mapping
Stop on degraded/failed/unknown redundancy, missing slot, identity mismatch or channel disagreement
agent_execution_scope: Verify the unique row and collect complete read-only IB/OOB inventories
Resolve actual redundancy and per-slot health records using owner maps
Compare raw/decoded states and complete Web parity
Report the source filters as conflicts and functional failover as uncovered
Perform no PSU service action, criteria invention or DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve the AMBIENT versus TEMP_MB filters and define intended record scope
Approve PSU topology, redundancy policy, state decoder and whether functional failover is a separate case
Resolve criteria gap and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED from passive evidence

review_improvement: Preserves the severe filter conflict, binds passive evidence to PSU topology and policy, and prevents a status query from being misrepresented as a failover test.
independent_technical_reasoning: Ambient and motherboard-temperature records cannot establish PSU redundancy unless the owner provides an unusual explicit mapping. Redundancy is a group property tied to populated modules and feeds, and a healthy reported bit still does not prove load-transfer capability. Safe static review therefore validates only the reported topology/state across surfaces and escalates the source defect and any functional requirement.
